svg.aria-label: PhanthyMotus peer mesh and security: five discovery providers converging on a peer registry; four collaboration links between two agent cores, with the unauthenticated DDS broadcast lane marked state-only; and a trust pipeline of identity, short-code pairing, pinned mTLS and role authorization, ending in the actuator double gate that prevents a peer from driving a motor directly
